features: 2U Windows server, RAID5 part numbers (e.g. 80TB RAID5 = 70TB usable)
Max channel count 64; up to 128 on RAID5 models with optional upgrades
Removable HDD bays; dual SSD upgrade available on RAID5 models
Optional alarm I/O card (AV-CIO4HP) and redundant power (AV-CDRPSU820)
ConteraCMR cloud managed recorder; works with the ConteraWS web services platform
Hardware warranty 3 years, 1 year advance replacement
notes: Values come from the ConteraCMR product matrices; no per-model datasheet is linked from the official pages.
